decision_contract.accept_only_if: The exact current official rendered Link and Trade Spot API page proves that the kickback record is client-beneficiary value distinct from the partner rebate record and binds a realized reward asset amount and event or trade lineage. Acceptance is limited to exact positive realized kickback from independently justified legitimate organic Spot activity on an already linked account after every incremental fee tax support compliance settlement and operating cost.
fail_closed_if: the beneficiary cannot be distinguished from the partner
the response cannot bind realized positive asset amount and lineage
documentation examples would be needed as current account rate eligibility or owned income
account creation linking referral customization or extra trading volume is needed
prohibited: opening relinking or customizing an account to chase kickback
creating enlarging splitting churning self-matching or rerouting volume
double counting the client kickback with partner rebate referral commission fee discount or promotion
calling any signed endpoint without explicit GET-only authority
placing orders or changing account or referral state
